tweets.text: BlackRock's IBIT just saw $300M walk out the door in a single day — largest outflow since January 2024. BTC below $60K is testing institutional conviction. The AI trade rotation that wrecked Korean markets last week is now hitting crypto ETFs.

Strategy holds 847,363 BTC bought at an average of $75,651. BTC is at $59K. They're sitting on a massive unrealized loss — and the stock rallied 14%. New framework authorizes selling up to $1.25B in BTC to fund a USD reserve. Wild times.

Bitcoin's next difficulty retarget opened the epoch at +7.54% on June 28. Four days later: -1.232%. The post-retarget mining spike has completely unwound — hashrate dropped from a 1,015 EH/s peak to 969 EH/s. Miners are voting with their rigs.

The CLARITY Act has a two-week window to clear the Senate before August recess. Needs 60 votes — that means corralling at least 7 Democrats. Senate returns July 13 with NDAA as the priority. The clock is loud.
